en.tagline: Design mobile app screens, then implement them
en.summary: This skill lets an agent design mobile app screens with Sleek through its REST API, then edit the project and fetch the HTML and renders. It also guides the agent to implement the design in React Native or HTML. It covers the API rules that are easy to get wrong, such as auth, response parsing, and retries.
problem: Designing a screen and turning it into code takes several API calls. Each call has its own response shape, run states, and error codes. Ids also carry no type, so an agent can mix one up with another.

With this skill, the agent follows a set order. It checks the HTTP status before reading the body, tracks each id by the field it came from, and uses the right screenshot framing for the user and for its own review.
fit: Designing a mobile app screen from a written brief
Turning an existing Sleek design into React Native or HTML
Running a design pass and an implementation pass in one request
unfit: Tasks that do not use Sleek or its API
Mobile work that needs no screen design
steps: Check that `SLEEK_API_KEY` is set. If it is not, run the device flow or send the user to the setup page to create a key.
Before sending a chat message, read designing.md to create the project, send the brief, and follow the create, chat, and screenshot loop.
Take a user shot to show the user, and a review shot of each component to check your own work.
Before writing code, read implementing.md to choose a version and convert the design to native code or HTML.
For each API response, check the HTTP status first, then read `data`. When an error includes a `data.url`, pass that link to the user as it is.

zh.tagline: 设计移动应用界面并实现为代码
zh.summary: 这个技能让智能体通过 Sleek 的 REST API 设计移动应用界面，并编辑项目、获取 HTML 和渲染图。它还指导智能体把设计实现为 React Native 或 HTML。文中说明了容易出错的 API 规则，包括鉴权、响应解析和重试。
problem: 设计一个界面并把它变成代码，需要调用多个 API。每个接口的响应结构、运行状态和错误码都不同。而且 id 不带类型信息，智能体可能会把不同资源的 id 混用。
使用这个技能后，智能体会按固定顺序操作：先检查 HTTP 状态再读取响应内容，按照 id 的来源字段来追踪每个 id，并根据场景为用户和自我检查使用正确的截图格式。
fit: 根据一段书面需求设计移动应用界面
把已有的 Sleek 设计转换为 React Native 或 HTML
在一次请求中同时完成设计和实现
unfit: 不使用 Sleek 或其 API 的任务
不需要界面设计的移动端工作
steps: 检查是否已设置 `SLEEK_API_KEY`。如果没有，运行设备授权流程，或引导用户到设置页面创建密钥。
在发送聊天消息之前，阅读 designing.md，按照创建、聊天、截图的流程创建项目并发送需求。
向用户展示用户截图，并为每个组件生成审查截图，用来检查自己的工作。
在编写代码之前，阅读 implementing.md，选择版本并把设计转换为原生代码或 HTML。
对每个 API 响应，先检查 HTTP 状态，再读取 `data`。错误中如果包含 `data.url`，原样把链接提供给用户。
